title: ClawKraft Public-to-Setup Initiation Intent
description: Signed, single-use, expiring intent that authorises a public clawkraft.com visitor to begin onboarding at setup.clawkraft.dev. The public side does not possess any signing secret; setup.clawkraft.dev binds the intent at receipt. No credential, identifier, email, contact value, or provider secret is ever carried in this envelope.

schema.description: Schema identifier; lets consumers reject incompatible envelopes.

iss.description: Issuer. Always the public surface; the public side never elevates to a privileged identity.

aud.description: Audience. Setup MUST reject intents whose audience is anything other than the canonical Setup signup endpoint.

iat.description: Issued-at, unix seconds. Setup MUST reject iat values unreasonably far from server clock.

exp.description: Expires-at, unix seconds. Must equal iat + ttl where ttl <= 300. Setup MUST reject expired intents.

jti.description: One-time identifier generated by the public side via a CSPRNG. Setup MUST refuse reuse (replay fails closed).

intent_type.description: Intent type. Reserved for explicit future values; unknown types are rejected.

source_surface.description: Public surface that originated the intent. Must match one of the canonical public surfaces.

destination.description: Destination Setup endpoint. Setup MUST refuse any other destination value and refuse to redirect elsewhere.

consent_version.description: Version of the public privacy/terms consent the visitor was shown before initiation. Optional but recommended.

not.description: Reject any intent carrying a credential-style field name. Defence-in-depth against future regressions.
